label: Google Drive
description: Create, organize, share, and manage files and folders in Google Drive.
notes: Auth: piece offers OAuth2 and service-account (JWT) auth; only OAuth2 maps to the declarative runtime, reusing the existing GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN credential from the live gdrive.* nodes for consistency (service-account JWT signing would need the piece runtime). All nodes hardcode supportsAllDrives=true (harmless superset of the AP include_team_drives checkbox, which is a boolean and cannot be templated). createFolder/createTextFile: AP's optional parent-folder dropdown became a required text field defaulting to 'root' (Drive's documented alias for My Drive), because optional keys cannot be conditionally omitted from JSON bodies. createTextFile builds the documented multipart/related upload body as a template string with a fixed boundary; AP's 'plain/text' option was corrected to the official 'text/plain' MIME type. copyFile drops AP's optional 'duplicate as' MIME conversion (optional JSON key). setPublicAccess drops AP's follow-up file-get/download enrichment (extra requests); the permission grant itself is the single transpiled request. gdrive.getFileMetadata replaces the live node: adds shared-drive support, an explicit fields projection, more lifted outputs, and urlencodes the path param. AP's search-folder-or-file and single-level list-files are already covered by the live gdrive.listFiles (arbitrary q parameter), so no duplicate was emitted; the recursive/download variants of list-files need the piece runtime.

nodes.label: Google Drive: Create Folder
nodes.description: Create an empty folder inside a Drive folder via the Drive v3 API.
nodes.search: google drive create folder new directory mkdir organize storage

config.label: Parent Folder ID
config.help: ID of the parent folder; use 'root' for the top level of My Drive. Found in the folder URL after /folders/

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope, obtained externally (e.g. Google OAuth 2.0 Playground)

nodes.label: Google Drive: Create Text File
nodes.description: Create a new text, CSV, or XML file in Drive from inline text content.
nodes.search: google drive create file text csv xml write save document upload content

config.label: Content
config.help: Text content written into the new file

config.label: Parent Folder ID
config.help: ID of the destination folder; use 'root' for the top level of My Drive

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope, obtained externally (e.g. Google OAuth 2.0 Playground)

nodes.label: Google Drive: Copy File
nodes.description: Duplicate an existing Drive file into a target folder under a new name.
nodes.search: google drive copy duplicate clone file template backup

config.label: File ID
config.help: ID of the file to copy

config.label: Destination Folder ID
config.help: ID of the folder to place the copy in; use 'root' for My Drive

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope, obtained externally (e.g. Google OAuth 2.0 Playground)

nodes.label: Google Drive: Move to Trash
nodes.description: Send a Drive file or folder to the trash without deleting it permanently.
nodes.search: google drive trash file remove recycle bin soft delete archive

config.label: File ID
config.help: ID of the file or folder to trash

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope, obtained externally (e.g. Google OAuth 2.0 Playground)

nodes.label: Google Drive: Delete File
nodes.description: Permanently delete a Drive file or folder, bypassing the trash.
nodes.search: google drive delete file remove permanent destroy erase

config.label: File ID
config.help: ID of the file or folder to delete permanently — this cannot be undone

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope, obtained externally (e.g. Google OAuth 2.0 Playground)

nodes.label: Google Drive: Share With User
nodes.description: Grant a user a role (reader, writer, etc.) on a Drive file or folder.
nodes.search: google drive share permission grant access user email role collaborate invite

config.label: Send Notification Email
config.help: Whether Google emails the user about the new access

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope, obtained externally (e.g. Google OAuth 2.0 Playground)

nodes.label: Google Drive: Set Public Access
nodes.description: Make a Drive file or folder accessible to anyone with the link at a chosen role.
nodes.search: google drive public access share anyone link permission open publish

config.label: Role
config.help: Access level granted to anyone with the link

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive scope, obtained externally (e.g. Google OAuth 2.0 Playground)
